description: The timestamp range includes scans stamped exactly at either endpoint.

c.request: For scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing `chronotag` as plain text), linked to their sites through `scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry` with unmatched scans left out, what is the average file size per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`) for each site risk evaluation status (`sites.riskeval`)? Ignore missing values, don't round, and show the status next to its average. The timestamp range includes scans stamped exactly at either endpoint.
c.sql: SELECT sites.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(scans.gbsize / NULLIF(scans.spanmin, 0)) AS average_gb_per_minute FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sites.riskeval IS NOT NULL AND scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sites.riskeval

a.request: Join each scan to its site (matching `scans.zoneref` to `sites.zoneregistry`, dropping scans with no matching site). Keep only scans whose `chronotag` lies between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', including both endpoints, comparing the values as plain text. For each site risk evaluation status (`sites.riskeval`), what is the average file size per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`), ignoring missing values and without rounding? Show the status and that average.
a.sql: SELECT sites.riskeval AS status, AVG(scans.gbsize / NULLIF(scans.spanmin, 0)) AS average_gb_per_minute FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sites.riskeval

d.request: For each `sites.riskeval` status, report the unrounded average of `scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin` for scans whose plain-text `chronotag` is between the two timestamps inclusive, joining only scans with a matching site on `scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry` and excluding rows with missing values needed for the calculation.
d.sql: SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag BETWEEN :start_timestamp AND :end_timestamp AND scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY sites.riskeval

b.request: For scans whose plain-text `chronotag` is between the two stated timestamps, inclusive, and whose `zoneref` matches a site, group by `sites.riskeval` and report each status with the unrounded average of `gbsize / spanmin`, excluding rows with missing values.
b.sql: SELECT si.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN :start_timestamp AND :end_timestamp AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY si.riskeval
b.raw: For scans whose plain-text `chronotag` is between the two stated timestamps, inclusive, and whose `zoneref` matches a site, group by `sites.riskeval` and report each status with the unrounded average of `gbsize / spanmin`, excluding rows with missing values.
